g.title: ReviewWise
g.text: ReviewWise M3 — local weekly review reports

g.title: cluster_local
g.text: USER'S COMPUTER — reviews stay inside this boundary

g.title: browser
g.text: Paste text or upload CSV; dates user-supplied

g.title: python
g.text: Up to 1,000 reviews; Python-assigned review IDs

g.title: session
g.text: No database / no automatic report files

g.title: cache
g.text: Key: text + model digest + prompt + schema + options
Retry reuses completed work; Start over clears it

g.title: validate
g.text: Python validates JSON + categories + verbatim quotes
One retry; unresolved failures stop the batch
Interpretation itself can still be wrong

g.title: count
g.text: Python: category → set of review IDs

g.title: report
g.text: Selected week + complete input + up to 3 actions
New/reused extraction counts; no second AI call

g.title: weights
g.text: Ollama model files on local disk

g.title: setup
g.text: Same launcher for first setup and later starts

g.title: internet
g.text: WinGet community source / python.org / Ollama installer
PyPI + package files / Ollama model registry
Network metadata only; no review text

g.title: secrets
g.text: No API keys or secrets required
